verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API reference with versioned endpoints (/wp-json/wc/v3/) and official client libraries, but nothing shows an interactive explorer, try-it console or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically power such a console. A static reference and SDKs are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
